faqAccordionItems.question: What to Expect on Test Day with RoadReady’s guidance
faqAccordionItems.answer:
We guide you through every step so your test day feels simple and stress-free:
  • Pick-up at home, we’ll collect you and you’ll be the one driving from the very start.
  • Arrive early at the DMV, we get there 15–20 minutes ahead of time so you can warm up on nearby routes and get comfortable.
  • Final practice & tips, we’ll go over DMV protocols, common test routes, and give you last-minute recommendations to help you stay calm and confident.
  • Support during your test, while you take the exam, we wait for you at the DMV.
  • Ride home after the test, when you’re done, we’ll drive back together, no matter the outcome.

faqAccordionItems.question: What documents do I need to take to the drive test?
faqAccordionItems.answer: Bring a valid ID, your Instruction Permit, proof of Nevada residency, vehicle registration, and proof of insurance.

faqAccordionItems.question: How many mistakes are allowed on a drive test in Nevada?
faqAccordionItems.answer: In Nevada, you can make a maximum of 15 minor driving faults, but zero serious or dangerous faults to pass the driving test. Any serious or dangerous fault, such as failing to stop at a stop sign or failing to yield to pedestrians, will result in an automatic failure of the test.

faqAccordionItems.question: What is the most common reason people fail in a drive test?
faqAccordionItems.answer: The most frequent reasons for failing include not following the examiner’s directions, weak observation skills (such as forgetting to check mirrors and blind spots), making improper turns or lane changes, and failing to signal. Other common issues are not obeying speed limits, incomplete stops, or poor overall vehicle control. With practice and proper instruction, these mistakes can be avoided.

faqAccordionItems.question: Can I drive immediately after passing my test?
faqAccordionItems.answer: Yes, you’ll receive a temporary license the same day, and your permanent one arrives by mail in a few weeks.
